features.name: Open or create a box by code
features.match_note: Places are made in the tree and a label's QR opens one; no typed or user-chosen code.

features.name: Scan a QR code or barcode
features.match_note: The QR on Chatelaine's own labels opens a place; existing barcodes are not read.

features.name: Open a box from an NFC tag
features.match_note: NFC tags are named for stage 11 only, pending their own decision.

features.name: Search items across all boxes
features.match_note: Search finds items by name and tag; grouping results by place is left to screen design.

features.name: See a list of all boxes
features.match_note: Place tree, place map and the homepage places card.

features.name: See what is in a box
Rename a box
features.match_note: A place carries the name of what it is.

features.name: Add an item to a box
features.match_note: An item exists with a name only and can be noted in a place.

features.name: Remove an item from a box
features.match_note: Moving out of a place is defined; deleting an item is mentioned only in passing (R143).

features.name: Delete a box and all its items
features.match_note: Deleting a place is implied (R117); what happens to its contents is not defined.

features.name: Choose a light or dark theme
features.match_note: No theme setting; the look is workshopped per screen.

features.name: Export data as JSON
features.match_note: Manual export of JSON and photos.

features.name: Import data from a file
features.match_note: Import and restore, merged by sync stamps.
